/* selectRcptnTrprList (문자수신대상자목록 조회) - Lee Hye Sun */ SELECT B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS RCPTN_TRPR_NM --수신자명 , B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS RCPTN_MBL_TELNO --암호화된수신휴대폰번호 , B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS CALL_TO --실제 발송될 수신번호 , B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS TRPR_NM --대상자명 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '11') AS TRPR_REL_SE_CD --관계구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '11') AS TRPR_REL --대상자와의관계 , A.TRPR_INFO_NO FROM AFA100 A LEFT JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} UNION ALL SELECT B.PRTCR_NM_ENCPT AS RCPTN_TRPR_NM --수신자명 , B.PRTCR_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS RCPTN_MBL_TELNO --암호화된수신휴대폰번호 , B.PRTCR_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS CALL_TO --실제 발송될 수신번호 , B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS TRPR_NM --대상자명 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '12') AS TRPR_REL_SE_CD --관계구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '12') AS TRPR_REL --대상자와의관계 , A.TRPR_INFO_NO FROM AFA100 A LEFT JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} UNION ALL SELECT A.PIC_NM_ENCPT AS RCPTN_TRPR_NM --수신자명 , A.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS RCPTN_MBL_TELNO --암호화된수신휴대폰번호 , A.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS CALL_TO --실제 발송될 수신번호 , B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS TRPR_NM --대상자명 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '13') AS TRPR_REL_SE_CD --관계구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRPR_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '13') AS TRPR_REL --대상자와의관계 , A.TRPR_INFO_NO FROM AFA100 A LEFT JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO}
ORDER BY TRPR_REL_SE_CD
